scripts.bench: rm -rf out/stress-frames && remotion render src/index.ts RenderStress out/stress-frames --sequence --image-format=jpeg
scripts.render:hello: rm -rf out/hello-frames && remotion render src/index.ts HelloBigNumber out/hello-frames --sequence --image-format=jpeg && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -framerate 30 -pattern_type glob -i "out/hello-frames/element-*.jpeg" -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p out/hello.mp4
scripts.render:finance: rm -rf out/finance-frames && remotion render src/index.ts FinanceDemo out/finance-frames --sequence --image-format=jpeg && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -framerate 30 -pattern_type glob -i "out/finance-frames/element-*.jpeg" -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p out/finance.mp4
